title: project.requests.list is bounded
summary: From v0.2-dev9 the list returns at most limit requests (default 10, range 1-100) and cuts each body to maxBodyBytes (default 1500, range 0-8000; 0 omits bodies) on a UTF-8 boundary. Each request carries bodyBytes (full size) and bodyTruncated; a subject over 300 bytes is cut and ends in "...". The result (schema oorexx.mcp.request.list/2) carries total (all matches), count (returned), hasMore, nextAfterId, limit, maxBodyBytes and order. Order is oldest first unless newestFirst is true. To page, pass afterId set to the last nextAfterId; an unknown afterId returns REQUEST_NOT_FOUND. Out-of-range or non-whole numbers return INVALID_ARGUMENT; nothing is clamped. With the defaults, ten 40,000-byte requests with 1,000-byte subjects serialise to under 30,000 characters.
authority: architecture Tom Dyer ("you need to fix that then", 26 Nov 2026 01:53); base v0.2-dev8 by ChatGPT; v0.2-dev9 change coded and written by Claude (Opus 5.5)
invariants: Cuts never split a UTF-8 character
Bad arguments are rejected, never clamped
procedure: List with unreadOnly true; for each truncated body call project.request.get; mark read only what you read
